notes: 02: extractMetadata returns only title+description; no favicon or preview/og:image collected. 03: title/description editable after save via edit dialog, but save form has no title/description fields to edit before saving. 04: PATCH and edit dialog cover title/description/note/tags but url is not editable. 07: cards show title/description/tags/url but never render a favicon. 14: no #tag syntax parsing; search is plain substring, tags only matched incidentally via searchableText. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesis parsing; substring match only. 16: no quote handling for exact-phrase match. 20: no multi-select UI or bulk-action endpoints. 21: no filter-scoped bulk action. 22: server always sorts by createdAt desc with no sort-key selection or UI. 23: note stored and displayed as escaped plain text, no markdown rendering. 24: no local HTML/PDF snapshot feature. 25: no Internet Archive integration. 29: no bundles/saved filters. 30: no Netscape HTML import. 31: no export. 32: no display/settings feature (default sort, displayed items, font size).
